BACKGROUND. /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/storygame/story_package/situation_trace.py has private helpers `_producers(package, fact_id, value)`, `_consumers(package, fact_id, exclude_transition_id=None)` and `_operation_value` that answer 'what can set this fact' and 'what reads this fact'. A new impact report needs the same answers, so they must live in one shared module, not be copied.

STEP 1, shared lookup in /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/storygame/story_package/dependencies.py: move those helpers there as PUBLIC functions with typed results: `producers(package, fact_id, value=True) -> list[Producer]` and `consumers(package, fact_id, exclude_transition_id=None) -> list[Consumer]`, where Producer and Consumer are frozen dataclasses (Producer: kind, record_id, scene_id (str | None), text; Consumer: kind in {'gate','wording','world'}, record_id, text). `text` must equal the strings the trace prints today so the trace output stays byte-identical. Keep the discovery behaviour exactly as it is now EXCEPT: audit every way a fact can become true at runtime and add the missing producer kinds so none is silently absent. Audit by reading /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/storygame/runtime/engine.py, state.py, validation.py and the story_package models: canonical bridge events and storylet-route realization operations (package.storylet_routes), incident outcome advantages/costs if they assert facts, scene entry facts, FactDelivery costs, ending markers if they assert, and world effects that assert. Add each kind that really asserts the fact with a Producer of its own kind name. Do not add a kind you cannot show asserts a fact. Report in your final message which kinds you added, and which you checked and rejected, each with the code location. Update /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/storygame/story_package/situation_trace.py to import from /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/storygame/story_package/dependencies.py and delete its private copies. The existing /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/tests/test_situation_trace.py must pass UNCHANGED for the existing assertions, and the rendered output for officer_presses_1a, i_2a_real_leak and t_1b_1c must be byte-identical to before except where an added producer kind appears (capture them before editing, in the scratchpad, and compare after; report any difference).

STEP 2, the impact report in /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/storygame/story_package/impact_report.py: `render_impact_report(root: Path, subject: str) -> str`. The subject resolves, in order, among: a fact id (package.knowledge.facts), a claim id (package.knowledge.knowledge), a pacing event id, a transition id, a storylet id. Zero matches -> ValueError("unknown subject '<s>'"); more than one kind -> ValueError("ambiguous subject '<s>': <kinds>"). Output is markdown, read-only, data only (no judgments, no 'flag', no 'gap', no proposals), title '# Impact report: <subject>', and one sentence 'Generated from the current story files. Read-only; edit the sources, not this page.' Sections for a FACT: '## Set by' (every producer with its kind, record id, scene), '## Read by' (every consumer with kind and record id), '## Claims' (claims that establish it and claims that require it, with ids), '## Tests that name it' (below). For a CLAIM: what it requires (each required fact with its producers), what it establishes (each fact with its consumers), its source storylet or realization, and the tests that name it. For a PACING EVENT, TRANSITION or STORYLET: the facts it reads (when, triggers, activation conditions, realization when) each with its producers, the facts it sets each with its consumers, then the tests that name it. When a list is empty print '- none'. 'Tests that name it': scan /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/tests/*.py (top level only; skip tests/fixtures and anything under bench/frozen) for lines containing the id as a whole token; print up to 5 'tests/file.py:LINE' per file, files sorted, at most 20 lines total, then '(N more)' if truncated; label the section so it is clear these are textual matches of the id, not proof the test covers it. Deterministic output. Cite a story source location 'file.yaml:LINE' for a record only on a line that defines it (a line `- id: X`, `{id: X, ...}` or a bare `X:` key); omit otherwise. Never invent one.

STEP 3: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/scripts/impact_report.py: argparse subject, --root (default /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/data/stories/continuity-initiative); prints the report; exit 0; exit 2 with the ValueError text on stderr. Mirror /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/scripts/situation_trace.py.

STEP 4, tests in /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/tests/test_impact_report.py (compact, shared helpers): one subject of each kind renders every section; the Set by list for a fact equals what dependencies.producers returns; an empty producer list prints '- none'; unknown and ambiguous subjects raise ValueError (build the ambiguous one in a tmp_path copy as /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/tests/test_situation_trace.py does); output is deterministic; the story files are byte-identical before and after; the test-name scan finds this test file's own id token in a synthetic tmp_path layout (make the tests directory scanned a parameter `tests_dir` with the repo default so tests can pass a tmp dir); /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/storygame/story_package/dependencies.py, /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/storygame/story_package/impact_report.py and /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/scripts/impact_report.py contain none of the story words (read the files and assert). Add to /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/tests/test_situation_trace.py one test that the trace imports the shared lookup (the trace module has no `_producers` or `_consumers` left).
HARD RULE: the new modules and scripts contain NO story names (no memory_card, kristin, patrol, laptop, k_sl_, t_1a, pursuit_1b, continuity), not even in comments or docstrings. Everything comes from the loaded StoryPackage. Tests may name story ids.
